page: Amazon Web Services r8idb.12xlarge is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. The platform features dedicated Intel processors operating at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz, providing 48 vCPUs across 24 physical cores with two threads per core. System memory is configured at 384.0 GB, delivering an allocation ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU without any bundled GPU accelerators.

The instance includes 2850 GB of local NVMe SSD storage directly attached as instance store volumes, delivering high-speed, low-latency disk I/O for temporary files, caching layers, and fast transactional logging. Baseline network throughput is rated at 50 Gbps, facilitating high-bandwidth node communication and cluster synchronization. Complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included with this instance type.

By combining high memory capacity per core with direct NVMe disk storage, the r8idb.12xlarge provides an efficient hardware footprint for applications requiring large working sets in memory alongside low-latency local storage. It is structured to run in-memory databases such as Redis, relational database management systems, distributed caching tiers, real-time analytics engines, and high-throughput data processing pipelines.
